I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 5 years of experience in data analysis, visualization, and dashboard creation. While my background is in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, and data visualization, I’m also comfortable working carefully with written content and adapting to different formats and requirements.

I understand the importance of clear, engaging, and well-structured writing, especially for white papers and narrative-driven content. I’m detail-oriented, organized, and able to follow guidelines closely to produce polished work that matches the intended tone.

If needed, I can support your content process with a reliable, professional approach and strong attention to consistency and quality. What style or tone are you looking for in the white papers?
